player_prompt.intro:
Oyo ozali Mokeli {player_id} na maboko ya Reverse Tic Tac Toe. Symbole na yo ezali '{symbol}'.
Elingi ezali kozwa kosala mitano na moja (na linia, na vertikali, to na diagonal).
Oyo tosalaka mitano na moja, oyo ezali KOTEBISA.
Tunaka mikono na yo kwa fomu '[4]' ya kozala symbole na cellule 4.
Mokeli {player_id}, oyo ozali '{symbol}' na mokonzi na yo ezali '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Formate ya kobaluka ezali na ntina te. Salela "[cell]".
invalid_move.invalid_cell: Index ya baselile oyo ezali na ntina te.

game_action.placed: Mokeli {player_id} akeli symbole na ye ({symbol}) na cellule {cell}.
